items.label: la dent
items.scene: A giant smiling TOOTH ("DAHN") stretches and wakes at DAWN, the sunrise glowing through the window behind it.

items.label: la fente
items.scene: A tiny FAWN ("FAHNT") peers through the narrow CRACK of the half-open shutter, its big eye in the slit.

items.label: la crête
items.scene: A rooster with a tall red CREST stands on a wooden CRATE ("KREHT") waiting his turn, comb held high.

items.label: la correspondance
items.scene: A postbag of CORRESPONDENCE ("koh-rehs-pohn-DAHNS") spills on the waiting bench, and the letters DANCE out.

items.label: le réflexe
items.scene: The dentist taps a cat's knee, and the REFLEX ("ray-FLEHKS") kick FLEXES its leg and sends a slipper flying.

items.label: l'interlocuteur
items.scene: A patient chats with his INTERLOCUTOR ("an-tehr-loh-kew-TUHR"), a parrot, who answers every question by opening wide.

items.label: le/la dentiste
items.scene: The DENTIST ("dahn-TEEST"), a cheerful beaver, polishes a crocodile's teeth while it pretends to be TEASED.
